justification: Both show low-relief human figures on a stone panel, and one figure in each holds an upright staff-like implement, but that is a generic correspondence. A depicts a single vertically stacked, densely ornamented figure with glyph-like blocks on a tall upright slab, while B shows a horizontal procession of profile figures leading a two-humped animal between rosette-studded border bands — different subject, orientation and rendering conventions.
